payload.name: Cueing effect
payload.fact: Adding visual cues relating elements of a picture to the text increases the effectiveness of multimedia instructions.

provenance.title: Multimedia instructions and cognitive load theory: Effects of modality and cueing
provenance.quote_or_locus: adding visual cues relating elements of a picture to the text (the cueing effect) both increase the effectiveness of multimedia instructions in terms of better learning results or less mental effort spent
